annotations.title: Check what the Hermoso bot may do in Discord

description: What the Hermoso bot is allowed to do in the brand's Discord server, feature by feature (polls, text-to-speech, pins, threads, roles, events), and exactly which permission each blocked one is missing. Use it when a Discord tool answers that a permission is missing: a server that added the bot before 15 November 2026 has the older, smaller set and needs the bot added again (connect_connector with provider discord and no fields returns the link), or the missing permission ticked on the Hermoso role. Free.

brand.description: WHICH PROFILE the post lives in, for THIS CALL ONLY: an id or exact name from list_brands, needed when it was published in a profile this connection is not pinned to. A name that matches no profile, or two, is REFUSED and nothing is done.
